Name: Make Marlon Real and Anthro Characters Continued Patch
Author: OokamiKasuke
Description:
These patch files are for the [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21319]Make Marlon Real[/url][/size] mod to be compatible with [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued (ACC)[/url].
Folders contain sprite and portrait files to replace human Marlon with his bird version from ACC.
Included is an edited content.json file for ACC to comment out Marlon changes that will obstruct these mods from working together.

[b][size=4]Install:[/size][/b]
- Make Marlon Real and Anthro Charactes Continued should be installed first.
- Download one of the zip files depending on if you use gender swap ACC or regular ACC. Unzip
the folder and copy the "[CP] Make Marlon Real" and "Anthro Characters Continued" folders into your "Stardew Valley\Mods\" folder. This should ask you to overwrite some files if done right.

Inside the config.json file for Make Marlon Real, portrait should be set to "vanilla" by default. If not and he has human portraits edit the file with note pad or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[/size][size=3]Sprites and Portraits are major edits of their respective mods:[/size][color=#6d9eeb][size=3]

[/size][/color][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Make Marlon Real[color=#d0e0e3] by[/color] [/size][/color][color=#e69138][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2421870][size=4]WerewolfMaster[/size][/url][/size][/color][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]
[/size][/color]
